predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher retained the concept without a version action.
predicates.productExplanation: The same source concept continues in the named edition.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher changed concept text between editions.
predicates.productExplanation: The source text changed and meaning must not be assumed unchanged.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher introduced the concept in the target edition.
predicates.productExplanation: The concept has no source-declared predecessor.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher removed the concept in the target edition.
predicates.productExplanation: The concept cannot silently retarget to another identifier.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher moved content from the named prior concept.
predicates.productExplanation: This is a directional source migration action.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher moved content to the named target concept.
predicates.productExplanation: This is a directional source migration action.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher directs reporting under another concept.
predicates.productExplanation: This action is not generic concept equivalence.

predicates.sourceMeaning: One source concept was split into multiple target concepts.
predicates.productExplanation: Migration is ambiguous and requires review.

predicates.sourceMeaning: Multiple source concepts were merged into one target concept.
predicates.productExplanation: Migration is many-to-one and not generic equivalence.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The source publishes a SKOS exact mapping.
predicates.productExplanation: Ambitions preserves the source predicate but derives no chained product edge.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The source publishes a SKOS close mapping.
predicates.productExplanation: The concepts are close only for an explicitly eligible purpose.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The object is broader under the source mapping.
predicates.productExplanation: This directional mapping cannot be reversed without a stored edge.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The object is narrower under the source mapping.
predicates.productExplanation: This directional mapping cannot be reversed without a stored edge.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The source publishes an associative SKOS mapping.
predicates.productExplanation: Association does not transfer claims or imply equivalence.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher relates education codes to occupation codes.
predicates.productExplanation: The many-to-many relevance is not a degree or qualification requirement.

predicates.sourceMeaning: The publisher relates exact O*NET-SOC and SOC releases.
predicates.productExplanation: The relation permits no sibling inheritance or current-job claim.

predicates.sourceMeaning: A publisher asserts an alignment to a CTDL concept.
predicates.productExplanation: The publisher claim is not independent verification or mastery.

predicates.sourceMeaning: A publisher asserts an association to a CASE framework node.
predicates.productExplanation: The publisher claim does not establish credit or acceptance.

predicates.sourceMeaning: A current authority publishes a preparation relationship.
predicates.productExplanation: The relationship is inspectable only within the source's exact authority scope.

predicates.sourceMeaning: A method proposes a relationship for review.
predicates.productExplanation: The candidate is not a consumer fact or source authority.
